stem: An analyst reports the net revenue retention of Voltmarkt's Business Care subscription (a monthly device-support plan for small offices) as total MRR on 1 October 2026 divided by total MRR on 1 October 2025. What is wrong with this?

options.text: The 2026 total includes businesses that subscribed during the year
The 2026 total leaves out the upgrades of the existing businesses
Net revenue retention should divide by the 2026 total, not the 2025 one
Net revenue retention should count businesses, not their monthly revenue
